             U3 LANDOWNERS’ NOTICE OF HEARING PARTICIPATION

       SOAH Order No. 6 in this proceeding requires each party to identify by May 22, 2026 the
number of participants (attorneys, witnesses, observers) who plan to attend the hearing on the
merits in person so Applicants can ensure the hearing space is sufficiently large to accommodate
all attendees. U3 Landowners plans to have up to 5 participants attend in person. Witness Chris
Rowntree will be available by Zoom if called to testify. U3 Landowners reserves the right to
supplement or amend this designation at such time as it may be required.

                                            Respectfully submitted,
